rationale: Theorem-strength revision required. THM-302 promises four correspondence properties but its lean_statement_sketch exposes only one proof target, and that target is false: execOrB32 = some (executed s') iff OrB32Step s i s' fails for the notExecuted constructor. Replace it with separate complete theorem declarations in the sketch: executed-soundness; false-guard/notExecuted equivalence; step completeness as executed-or-notExecuted outcome with the same post-state; and execOrB32 = none iff no OrB32Step exists. Add an explicit false-guard state-unchanged theorem and a non-destination value-register frame theorem. Strengthen predicate preservation to all OrB32Step cases or justify its executed-only restriction without redundant hypotheses. Ensure every required theorem appears as its own full 'theorem ...' declaration because proof-plan extracts declarations from lean_statement_sketch. Also correct semantic claim_counts to SOURCE_FACT=2, DERIVED_INTERPRETATION=4, DESIGN_DEPENDENCY=1, OPEN_QUESTION=1. Preserve approved semantics and do not add proofs.
